motion: Does consciousness fundamentally pervade reality and point toward God?

moves.currentDescription: Consciousness and matter are phenomenologically different phases of one underlying entity, while consciousness is the one directly known term.
moves.lockedProposition: Consciousness and matter are phenomenologically different phases of one underlying entity, while consciousness is the one directly known term.
